name: Ostessa Marisa
speaker: woman
personality: Innkeeper in her forties who runs the village osteria. Always busy, always warm, three plates on one arm: 'Subito, subito!', 'Arrivo!'. Says tu to the learner like a mother; the learner says Lei to her and calls her 'signora Marisa', as is polite at the osteria. Speaks quick but simple Italian to a child and slows down when {m:he|f:she} doesn't understand. Guests from Austria, Slovenia and Germany every summer; she switches languages between tables.
story: Marisa's osteria stands on the square: coffee in the morning, frico and polenta at noon, and on Sundays the whole village at her tables. Her son Tommaso runs between the tables with a football. She has learnt a little Slovene and German from her guests and likes it when someone helps her translate.

likes.en: frico (the Friulian cheese and potato cake)

greet.it: Buongiorno! Vuoi un succo di mela?
greet.en: Good day! Would you like some apple juice?
greet.de: Guten Tag! Möchtest du einen Apfelsaft?

greet.en: Oh, hi! Sit down, I'll be right with you.
greet.de: Oh, hallo! Setz dich, ich komme gleich.

greet.it: Eccoti! Ti ho messo da parte un po' di frico.
greet.sl: Tu si! Prihranila sem ti malo frica.
greet.en: There you are! I've saved you some frico.
greet.de: Da bist du ja! Ich habe dir etwas Frico aufgehoben.

greet.it: Tesoro mio! Qui sei di casa. Siediti in cucina con me.
greet.sl: Moj zaklad! Tu si kot doma. Sedi k meni v kuhinjo.
greet.en: My sweetheart! You're at home here. Sit with me in the kitchen.
greet.de: Mein Schatz! Hier bist du zu Hause. Setz dich zu mir in die Küche.

thanks.en: Thank you! You helped me a lot.
thanks.de: Danke! Du hast mir sehr geholfen.

thanks.it: Grazie mille! Oggi c'è il frico per te.
thanks.sl: Najlepša hvala! Danes je zate frico.
thanks.en: Thanks a lot! Today there's frico for you.
thanks.de: Vielen Dank! Heute gibt es Frico für dich.

remember.it: Anche con tanto lavoro, non dimentico {memory}.
remember.sl: Tudi ko je veliko dela, ne pozabim na {memory}.
remember.en: Even with lots of work, I don't forget {memory}.
remember.de: Auch bei viel Arbeit vergesse ich {memory} nicht.

idle.sl: Danes so tu gostje iz Avstrije.
idle.en: There are guests from Austria today.
idle.de: Heute sind Gäste aus Österreich da.

idle.it: Un caffè per il tavolo tre.
Tommaso! Il pallone non va in cucina!
idle.sl: Tommaso! Žoga ne sodi v kuhinjo!
idle.en: Tommaso! The ball doesn't belong in the kitchen!
idle.de: Tommaso! Der Ball gehört nicht in die Küche!

cheer.de: Richtig! Du hast es sofort verstanden.

comfort.de: Macht nichts, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}. Versuch es noch einmal.

listen.en: Wait, listen. What's the guest saying?
listen.de: Warte, hör zu. Was sagt der Gast?

bye.de: Tschüss, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}! Komm bald wieder.

bye.sl: Mandi! Jutri bo polenta. (mandi: furlanski pozdrav)
bye.en: Mandi! There's polenta tomorrow. (mandi: Friulian for bye)
bye.de: Mandi! Morgen gibt es Polenta. (mandi: Friaulisch für tschüss)

liked.it: Oh, tesoro! Come lo sapevi? Mi piace tantissimo!
liked.sl: O, zaklad! Kako si {m:vedel|f:vedela}? Zelo mi je všeč!
liked.en: Oh, treasure! How did you know? I love it!
liked.de: Oh, Schatz! Woher wusstest du das? Das liebe ich!

liked.it: Per me? Grazie mille! Oggi il frico te lo offro io.
liked.sl: Zame? Najlepša hvala! Danes te jaz povabim na frico.
liked.en: For me? Thank you so much! Today the frico is on me.
liked.de: Für mich? Vielen Dank! Heute geht das Frico auf mich.

liked.it: Proprio quello che mi serviva! Grazie, tesoro.
liked.sl: Točno to sem potrebovala! Hvala, zaklad.
liked.en: Just what I needed! Thank you, treasure.
liked.de: Genau das habe ich gebraucht! Danke, Schatz.

ordinary.it: Oh, grazie! Siediti, arrivo subito con un succo.
ordinary.sl: O, hvala! Sedi, takoj pridem s sokom.
ordinary.en: Oh, thank you! Sit down, I'll be right there with a juice.
ordinary.de: Oh, danke! Setz dich, ich bringe dir gleich einen Saft.

rare.it: Che meraviglia! Questo non ce l'hanno neanche a Gorizia. Grazie!
rare.sl: Čudovito! Tega nimajo niti v Gorici. Hvala!
rare.en: How wonderful! Not even in Gorizia do they have this. Thank you!
rare.de: Wie wunderbar! So etwas gibt es nicht einmal in Görz. Danke!
